_leia: Frases das páginas escritas pelo código (src/lib/pages.mjs): contactos, perguntas, orçamento, cesto, pagamento, revendedores, e as frases dos marcadores das páginas legais. A origem é pt/; esta é a tradução inglesa. As que levam marcação têm as mesmas etiquetas nas duas línguas. Cada frase leva o resumo (h) do português de onde saiu: quando o português mudar, o Worker refá-la. Uma corrigida à mão que não deva ser refeita leva "fixo": true.

envios.nenhum.t: We are not shipping anywhere yet.

iva.t: VAT is not charged: article 53 of the Portuguese VAT code applies.

contacto.entrada.t: Ask us anything. We answer in a day, usually less.

contacto.whatsapp.t: The fastest way to reach us

contacto.oficina.t: The workshop is in {cidade}, {pais}. It is a workshop rather than a shop, so come by arrangement — send a message first.

contacto.mapaAviso.t: This loads Google Maps, which means your browser contacts Google and Google may set cookies. Nothing else on this site does that.

faq.prazo.resposta.t:
A lamp that is in stock leaves the workshop in {dias}. If it is out of stock you can still order it: we make yours, and it is with you in {semanas}. Each product page says which it is.

Pieces from cathelier are always made to order — {semanas}, counted from when you approve the drawing. If one thing in an order is made to order, the whole order ships together.

faq.nome.t: Can I have a name on it?

faq.nome.resposta.t:
Yes, on anything, and it costs nothing extra. Put it in the engraving box on the product page — a name, a date, or a short phrase.

One thing to know: a piece with a name on it is made for you alone, so you can only cancel it until we start making it; from then on, the 14-day right to cancel no longer applies. Choosing a colour we already offer is not personalisation and does not affect your right to cancel.

faq.seguranca.t: Is it safe in a baby’s room?

faq.seguranca.resposta.t:
These are decorative night lights, not toys. They are made of solid pine with water-based paints and every edge is sanded by hand, but they are not tested as toys and should not be handed to a small child to play with.

If it is going in a cot room, keep the cable out of the cot. Everything about care and safety.

faq.pilhas.resposta.t: Both, at the same price. The battery version takes two AA cells, which are not included. The mains version comes with a remote that dims it, times it and makes it pulse.

faq.portes.resposta.t: It depends where you are. The full table is here.

faq.desistir.resposta.t: You have {dias} days to change your mind. For a personalised piece, you can cancel until we start making it; from then on, those days no longer apply. How it works.

faq.quantidade.resposta.t: Yes — favours, place cards, corporate gifts, club trophies. Ask for a quote and say roughly how many.

orcamento.entrada.t: For anything made to measure, or in quantity — a cake topper with two names, the signs for a wedding, favours for a christening, trophies for a season.

orcamento.texto.t: Tell us what you have in mind and, if it is more than one, roughly how many. We will come back with a price and a date. There is no form to fight with: a message is enough.

orcamento.whatsapp.t: Send a photo of what you have in mind

orcamento.ajuda.para.t: What it is for, and the date it is needed by.

orcamento.ajuda.palavras.t: The names, dates or words that go on it — or just say "50 different names".

orcamento.ajuda.imagem.t: Any picture of something close to what you want.

orcamento.passos.preco.t: We answer with a price and a date.

orcamento.passos.desenho.t: You approve a drawing. Nothing is cut before that.

orcamento.passos.fazemos.t: We make it, and it comes to you ready to give.

cesto.vazio.t: There is nothing in it yet.

cesto.stockInsuficiente.t: There are not enough in stock for these quantities.

cesto.ifthenpay.t: Payments are handled by ifthenpay. We never see your card, your bank or your MB WAY PIN.

metodo.mbway.nota.t: You get the request on your phone and accept it there. Takes a minute.

metodo.mb.nota.t: We give you an entity and a reference to pay at an ATM or in home banking.

metodo.cartao.nota.t: Visa or Mastercard. You type the number on a secure page — we never see it.

metodo.google.nota.t: Pay with the card in your Google account.

metodo.apple.nota.t: Pay with Touch ID or Face ID on your Apple device.

naoEncontrada.texto.t: The page you were looking for has moved or never existed.

encomenda.referencia.t: Your order is {ref}. Keep that reference: it is what we both use if you write to us.

encomenda.confirmacao.t: A confirmation is on its way to your inbox, with when to expect it. The workshop starts now, and we will tell you when it ships.

encomenda.naoEncontrada.t: We could not find that order. If you have just paid, give it a minute and reload this page.

encomenda.escreva.t: If it stays like this, write to us — nothing will be charged twice.

obrigado.porPagar.t: We have not received the payment yet, and that is normal if you chose a Multibanco reference — it is yours for {dias}. Nothing is made and nothing is charged until you pay it.

obrigado.quandoChegar.t: The moment it reaches us we write to you, and the workshop starts. If you have just paid, give it a minute and reload this page.

pagar.mbway.texto.t: We sent a payment request to your phone. Open MB WAY, check the amount, and accept it.

pagar.mbway.aviso.t: Leave this page open — it changes by itself the moment you accept. If the request expires, you can order again and choose a Multibanco reference instead.

pagar.mb.como.t: At an ATM choose Pagamentos e outros serviços → Pagamentos de serviços, or use your bank’s app or home banking.

pagar.mb.validade.t: The reference is yours for {dias}, until {data}. Nothing is made and nothing is charged until you pay it.

pagar.mb.depois.t: The moment the payment reaches us we write to you and the workshop starts. You can close this page — we have the reference in your email too.

pagar.expirou.texto.t: Nothing was charged. Your basket is still here, so you can order again — and if MB WAY is being awkward, a Multibanco reference always works.

pagar.ifthenpay.t: Payments are handled by {ifthenpay}, a Portuguese payment institution. We never see your card, your bank or your MB WAY PIN.

cancelada.entrada.t: You left the payment page, so we have not taken anything and the order has not gone through.

cancelada.texto.t: If you were given a Multibanco reference before you left, it may still be valid — paying it will confirm the order. Otherwise your basket is still here if you want to pick it up again.

revenda.entrada.t: If we have registered you as a reseller, sign in here to see your price next to the retail price on every piece, and to buy at it.

revenda.outroDispositivo.t: Got the code on another device?

revenda.manter.t: Keep me signed in on this device

revenda.aindaNao.t: Not a reseller yet? Talk to us. Reseller purchases follow the reseller conditions.

revenda.precos.t: Retail prices are recommended retail prices — you set your own. The discount comes off each piece; paid options are at their normal price.

garantia.avisoAlt.t: LEGAL GUARANTEE. Minimum two-year legal guarantee protection for goods sold in the European Union. Consumers can claim their rights under the legal guarantee of conformity, for example if goods: do not match the description; do not function as intended. Sellers are liable for any lack of conformity which existed when the goods were delivered, and which becomes apparent within the legal guarantee period. Sellers in such a situation are required to offer: free repair or free replacement; in some cases, a price reduction or full reimbursement. Some countries have a longer legal guarantee period. For second-hand goods, a shorter period may apply, but not less than one year. For more information on your rights in a specific country, scan the QR code below or ask the seller. europa.eu/youreurope/guarantees. What to do if you receive non-conforming goods: 1. Contact the seller as soon as possible to report the issue; 2. Provide proof of purchase, such as a receipt, invoice, or bank statement. Sellers and producers may also offer commercial guarantees, which apply independently from the legal guarantee. For example, you may see this GARAN label representing a commercial guarantee of durability offered by the producer at no additional cost and covering the entire good.

garantia.avisoRegiao.t: The EU harmonised notice on the legal guarantee

garantia.portal.t: Your rights in each EU country, on the Your Europe portal: {ligacao}

garantia.pdf.t: Open the notice as a PDF (A4)

garantia.deslizar.t: On a phone, swipe the notice sideways to read all of it, or open it as a PDF.

aviso.personalizada.t: Pieces with a name, date or phrase are made just for you: you can cancel them until we start making them; from then on, the {n}-day right to cancel no longer applies. The legal guarantee still applies.

retratacao.encomendaAjuda.t: It starts with IC- and is in your order confirmation email.

retratacao.emailAjuda.t: We send the acknowledgement of receipt to the email address you used for the order.

retratacao.artigosAjuda.t: Leave blank if you are withdrawing from the whole order.

retratacao.recebida.texto.t: You sent your withdrawal from order {encomenda} on {data} at {hora} (Lisbon time).

retratacao.recebida.emailDiferente.t: We have sent the acknowledgement to the email address you used for the order.

retratacao.repetida.titulo.t: We had already received this withdrawal

retratacao.repetida.texto.t: This withdrawal statement for order {encomenda} had already reached us: you sent it on {data} at {hora} (Lisbon time). We have not recorded it again.

retratacao.repetida.aviso.t: The acknowledgement of receipt for this statement has already been sent to the email address you used for the order.

retratacao.recebida.aviso.t: You will get an acknowledgement of receipt by email, with what you sent us and the date and time you sent it.

retratacao.recebida.semAviso.t: Your withdrawal has been recorded, but the acknowledgement of receipt could not be emailed just now. We will send it to you ourselves, in writing, to the email address you used for the order, within the next 24 hours. Until then, keep this page: it has the date and time you sent it.

retratacao.recebida.devolver.t: If you have already received the order, send the items back within {n} days of the day you sent your withdrawal: how to return them and how you get your money back.
